It changes slot 5 by adding last-round defection and removing the early unconditional cooperation block so it retaliates immediately.

STRATEGY: Parent (slot 5) retaliates only after two consecutive opponent defections, with probabilistic retaliation at higher defection rates. Trace simulates pure Tit-for-Two-Tats plus last-round defection against Always-D, TFT, slot 1, slot 8, Always-C, and slot 10. Changed to a hybrid: cooperate on first move, defect on last round, defect if opponent defected last round and n >= 90, else defect only on two consecutive defections, else cooperate.
